The report covers the following topics: a letter to shareholders, production activities, business results, personnel, output, dividends, investment plans, raw material prices, sustainable development, and plans for 2026 [p. 1](#page=1).

Key business results include:
*   Food segment revenue: 1,120 billion VND, with a growth of +8.5% [p. 4](#page=4).
*   Beverage segment revenue: 870 billion VND, with a growth of +15.2% [p. 4](#page=4).

Sao Mai operates three factories: Binh Duong (45% of total output), Hai Phong (35%), and Can Tho (20%) [p. 3](#page=3). The average capacity utilization rate is 78% [p. 3](#page=3).

In 2025, water consumption per ton of product decreased by 18% compared to 2023, and all paper packaging was collected and recycled [p. 10](#page=10).

Sao Mai plans to increase the capacity of the Binh Duong factory and expand cold storage, with an annual investment of 120 billion VND for this project [p. 8](#page=8). This project aims to create jobs and export canned products to new markets [p. 8](#page=8).
